dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave trailing edge forming a smooth inward curve from the posterior base to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute point with a minimal pixel radius at the highest morphological tip.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep linear ascent relative to the longitudinal dorsal axis.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Uniform convex arc forming a rounded melon profile.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short and robust pixel length extending from the cranial base.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse angle at the distinct pixel junction between the melon and the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly defined caudal flukes with a deep median notch and pointed tips.
